errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва стойностите в милиарди щатски долари, започвайки от 0 и достигайки до 2, означени на равномерни интервали от 0,25 на 0,25.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the vertical axis shows the numerical values. The vertical axis actually shows the names of the countries, while the horizontal axis shows the numerical values.
The chart is a horizontal bar chart, where values are represented by the length of the bars, not their height. The description incorrectly refers to the 'height' of the bars.
